pages.title: block.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_core
pages.text: The Arcane Matrix Core is a late-game Source generator unlocked after completing the Processor, Smelter, and Crusher. Its recipe requires all five Sourcelinks and the three processing crystals.

Build three intersecting 5×5 frame rings around the Core. One complete ring starts the Matrix; extending the other two increases Source production. Arcane Amplifiers may replace the six axial vertices.
